meta.name: seo-content
meta.description: Content quality and E-E-A-T analysis with AI citation readiness assessment. Use when user says "content quality", "E-E-A-T", "content analysis", "readability check", "thin content", or "content audit".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析内容质量与E-E-A-T，评估AI引用准备度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要提升网站内容质量和搜索引擎表现
copy.tagline_en: Analyze content quality and E-E-A-T, assess AI citation readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve website content quality and search engine performance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你提供的网页 URL，评估内容质量、E-E-A-T 信号（经验、专业度、权威性、可信度）以及 AI 引用就绪度，并给出分数和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“内容质量”、“E-E-A-T”、“内容分析”等关键词时，或直接提供网页 URL 要求分析时触发。

say.text: 分析这个页面的内容质量和 E-E-A-T。
say.note: Claude 会抓取 URL 并输出评分和问题列表。

say.text: 检查这篇博客的 AI 引用就绪度。
say.note: Claude 会评估内容是否容易被 AI 搜索引用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes a provided URL for content quality, E-E-A-T signals (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness), and AI citation readiness, then outputs scores and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "content quality", "E-E-A-T", "content analysis", or when you provide a URL for analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this page's content quality and E-E-A-T.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the URL and output scores and issues.

say_en.text: Check this blog post's AI citation readiness.
say_en.note: Claude will assess if the content is easily citable by AI search engines.
